findings.method: Sorted official soil-depth observations by great-circle distance from the market locator without changing source coordinates or depths.

Servitudes, joint facilities, cadastral acts, road rights and mortgages remain unresolved.
The seller map is nonbinding and no field survey or boundary determination exists.

NOKA identifies effective Avstyckningsplan 0581K-22D:1008 at the address point and its source files are acquired. Norrkoping also confirms that the outdated 1984 Svartinge strategic plan continues until replacement, while the 2026 FOP is only a consultation proposal. That proposal places the locator in Ovre Svartinge residential context and proposes 1,000-1,200 m2 minimum plots, but it is not entitlement. The current property-to-historic-lot mapping, exact present legal effect and amendment chain remain unresolved.
Current Boverket guidance and the 2025-12-01 effective profile are bound for this assessment date.
Neither H30 nor H50 eligibility can be determined before plan status, principal-building facts, aggregate areas, placement and protections are resolved.
No authoritative buildable envelope may be drawn while boundary, planning, rights, environmental and access gates remain open.
The exact 1 m STAC item is identified, but its raster asset returned HTTP 401 and no plot clip or deterministic derivations exist.

Official screening shows glaciofluvial sediment, strong nearby depth variability, proposed municipal geotechnical zone 2 and the Ovre Svartinge groundwater body at the locator. The draft layer says geotechnical investigation is required; plot-specific geotechnical, groundwater, radon, contamination and infiltration evidence is absent.

The address locator did not intersect the draft municipality's extreme-rain, 100-year or BHF flood polygons, but that point-only result cannot establish absence across an unverified parcel. Terrain bytes, legal boundary, local drainage and parcel-wide municipal screening remain incomplete.

The draft municipal point screen returned no intersection with its Glan water-protection, queried nature, reserve or Natura polygons, but a point-only consultation layer cannot prove parcel-wide absence or legal status. The national WFS responses remain inconclusive, and shoreline protection plus the authoritative Glan zone overlay remain unresolved.

Two published heritage points occur about 472 m from the market locator. The public EBH layer also returns four known or suspected activity records within 2 km, nearest a fuel-handling record about 312 m away and a risk-class 2 nursery about 681 m away. These are context signals; full geometry/uncertainty, plot history, detailed EBH records and sampling remain incomplete.
Road proximity and the seller listing cannot prove legal or permitted access, road manager approval, gradients or construction access.
The seller statement that municipal VA is paid is not a provider-confirmed capacity, connection-point, cost or lead-time response.
No Ledningskollen case, provider line response, permit, notification or start clearance has been requested.
